auditor_fern: Hi team — auditor request from SOC2 fieldwork: we need a bundled evidence package for an RBAC adjustment that affected the serviceAccount `inference-controller` on 2025-09-10. Required items: (A) PR and merge commit, (B) exact deploy timeline (minute/second), (C) KMS events (Decrypt and GenerateDataKey) referencing alias `rdw-inference-key` during the window, (D) any alias/key rotation activity +/- 24h, and (E) vuln triage/ops notes. Where should I pull each artifact from?

riley_oncall: Hi @auditor_fern — PR + CI artifact + CloudTrail + KMS history + k8s audit snippet will cover everything. We have an exporter that packages these with checksums and a timeline.csv.

janet_infra: PR is github.com/redwood/inference/pull/5288, merge commit e9a7b2c (merged 2025-09-10T13:44:10Z). CircleCI job 13177 executed `kubectl apply -f rollout-controller-20250910.yaml` at 2025-09-10T13:44:42Z. CI artifact saved: s3://redwood-audit/ci-artifacts/2025/09/10/deploy-controller-1344.json.

omar_sec: For KMS, query CloudTrail for eventName in (Decrypt, GenerateDataKey) and requestParameters.keyId matches alias/rdw-inference-key for 2025-09-10T13:30:00Z..2025-09-10T14:00:00Z. Example Splunk query: 
```
index=cloudtrail (eventName=Decrypt OR eventName=GenerateDataKey) "rdw-inference-key" | table _time, eventName, userIdentity.principalId, requestParameters.encryptionContext, requestParameters.keyId
```

auditor_fern: Does CloudTrail preserve encryptionContext so we can tie the KMS call to the serviceAccount rather than the node/role? Also please confirm whether alias -> key mapping changed recently.

omar_sec: Yes — our envelope wrapper sets encryptionContext.service_account and encryptionContext.deploy_id. CloudTrail requestParameters.encryptionContext will include `service_account:inference-controller`. Regarding alias mapping: there was an alias rotation earlier that week (2025-09-09). We'll include a KMS key history snapshot (ListAliases/DescribeKey) for 2025-09-08..2025-09-11 to show alias -> key ARN mapping.

janet_infra: K8s audit snippet showing SA binding and pod create time saved at s3://redwood-audit/k8s-audit/2025/09/10/sa-bind-controller-1344.json. We'll include a filtered CloudTrail JSON with only Decrypt/GenerateDataKey events and a CSV highlighting encryptionContext.

riley_oncall: I'll run the exporter and include mapping.txt that maps artifacts to SOC2 CC6.1 and ISO A.9. Command I'll run: `redwood-audit export --from 2025-09-10T13:30:00Z --to 2025-09-10T14:00:00Z --keys rdw-inference-key --include-ci --include-cloudtrail --include-k8s --include-kms-history --output s3://redwood-audit/evidence/1934567000-controller-bundle.tar.gz`

export-bot: Evidence export started by riley_oncall. Job ID eexp-ff11 queued.

auditor_fern: Please list which fields you redact and whether principal ARNs and encryptionContext are preserved. Auditors need principal/service_account/timestamp intact for binding proof.

omar_sec: Redaction policy: we redact node hostnames, EC2 instance IDs, and external IP addresses. We preserve IAM ARNs/principalId, encryptionContext key/value pairs, timestamps, and requestParameters.keyId. Each artifact will include a SHA256 checksum and a checksums.sha256 file. We will also include an internal-only forensic pod env snapshot (separate path) if you request it under NDA.

janet_infra: Vulnerability notes linked in PR: INFSEC-1491. Summary: minor TLS dependency upgrade to mitigate CVE-2025-0899; patched in the same deploy; monitoring for 48h. Will include `INFSEC-1491-summary.txt` in the bundle.

riley_oncall: Exporter will also generate `timeline.csv` at 10s granularity with `_time,artifact,detail` and an `attestation.txt` signed by oncall certifying the export and redaction steps.

export-bot: Evidence export complete: s3://redwood-audit/evidence/1934567000-controller-bundle.tar.gz (sha256: 6c9b2a...)

auditor_fern: Received the bundle URL. I'll validate the mapping and timeline tomorrow; if auditors request raw CloudTrail for a wider window we will coordinate access. Thanks all :thumbsup:

omar_sec: For the record, we also captured KMS UpdateAlias and DescribeKey events around 2025-09-09 to show alias reassignment: s3://redwood-audit/kms-history/2025-09-08-11/kms-history.json (included).

riley_oncall: Marking this thread resolved for our side. Reopen if auditor requests additional forensics or raw logs.

auditor_fern: Acknowledged 
Thanks everyone.
